Whey Protein Isolate (WPI) is a high-quality protein powder with approximately 90% protein content and minimal carbohydrates, fats, and lactose. Known for its clean nutritional profile, WPI is a great option for those aiming to increase daily protein intake while following a low-carb or lactose-conscious diet. This protein powder contains a naturally occurring amino acid profile and is commonly used to support an active lifestyle and balanced nutrition goals.

Select Protein is the protein powder that started it all — a premium blend of whey and casein that delivers sustained amino acid release, superior digestion, and flavors so good you’ll actually look forward to your next shake. Most protein powders cut corners on ingredients. Select doesn’t. Milk protein isolate is the #1 ingredient — a rare choice in the industry due to its higher cost, but one that pays off with naturally low lactose content, exceptional digestibility, and a richer, creamier texture that makes every flavor taste exactly like its name. ✔ Whey + casein blend — shown to be more effective than 100% whey alone for muscle protein synthesis ✔ Milk protein isolate as the #1 ingredient — very low in lactose for easy digestion ✔ Third-party tested for quality and purity ✔ Low carb & gluten free — fits virtually any diet ✔ Flavors developed in-house — crafted to taste true to name, every single time Available in 10+ flavors — from fan favorites like Gourmet Vanilla and Chocolate Truffle to indulgent picks like Chocolate Peanut Butter Cup and Snickerdoodle — and in sizes from a 5-serving trial & travel bag to a 55-serving bulk tub.
